name: Alterac Pass
theme: Free your faction's prisoner and hold the Prison Camp to summon a Cavalry charge down all three lanes.
firstObjective: 3:00 (subsequent spawns ~1:50–2:30 after Cavalry ends, scaling shorter with match time)
spawnPattern: Two Prison Camps spawn simultaneously between Top/Mid and Mid/Bottom; exact pair varies across cycles

mechanic.title: Prison Camps & Cavalry Charge
mechanic.description: Channel to unlock the Prison Camp and hold the capture point until the timer completes while defending against enemy Heroes and Guards that pause or recapture it. Completing the capture summons Cavalry down all three lanes that buff nearby allied Heroes' movement speed and damage.

camps.name: Gnoll Siege Camps (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Three Armored Gnolls per camp pushing mid lane; basic attacks apply stacking Armor reduction to enemy Heroes and structures.

camps.name: Boss / Ice Giants (2 Camps)
camps.notes: One Ice Giant per top and bottom lane camp, immune to Bribe. Uses Mega Smash (AoE melee stun) and Ice Shard (ranged slow).

strategy: Because two Prison Camps activate at once, coordinate split rotations, long-range channel interrupts, and sustained skirmishing to hold your point without letting the enemy finish theirs. Pair Cavalry pushes with Gnoll or Ice Giant pressure to crack forts and keeps.
notes: Standard Cores are replaced by Generals (Vanndar Stormpike and Drek'Thar) using Whirlwind and Charge. Each standing Keep grants the General +20 Armor, and they regenerate health out of combat—avoid forcing the General while all three Keeps remain up.
